_comment: Author-approved merge of SITE_STOCKLAND_MP into SITE_MACQUARIE_PARK_DC (RG-084).
The duplicate is deleted at its source in data/seed_data.py; this pack carries its
content onto the surviving row, corrects the address from the consent's Schedule 1,
and keeps the directory's AWS / under-construction / September-2026 claims as
unconfirmed claims (RG-102) rather than adopting them. Loads last.

set.notes: SCHEDULE 1 APPLICANT ON THE SIGNED CONSENT: Stockland Trust Management Limited (SSD-10467, determined 28 May 2021) - a second Stockland entity alongside Stockland Development Pty Limited at 1-5 Khartoum Road (SSD-63235720, a different lot, still a separate record). Applicant recovered in the 2026-09-18 pypdf re-extraction (RG-065). MERGED 2026-11-15 (RG-084, approved by the author): the former SITE_STOCKLAND_MP row ('Stockland Macquarie Park Stage 1 data centre') described this same consent and has been retired; what it held is carried here. The consent's site is 11-17 Khartoum Road AND 33-39 Talavera Road, Lot 1 DP 633221 - the address previously recorded named only the Khartoum Road frontage. The Department's assessment gives a CIV of approximately $263.6 million (the retired row said A$264m) and describes a development that 'presents as a five-storey warehouse building' (the retired row said five-storey). Status stays 'approved', which is what the consent records. NOT adopted from the retired row: 'under construction', an AWS end-user and a north-zone start in September 2026. Those were seeded from CertifiedStrategic.com, whose archived article does not mention Stockland at all, so no archived source states them; they are unconfirmed claims, kept here as claims and put to a human as RG-102. No IT capacity is recorded: the retired row had none and no capacity has been read from this consent.

set.notes: RESOLVED 2026-11-15: one project, one consent, one record. The signed SSD-10467 consent names Stockland Trust Management Limited as applicant and the site as 11-17 Khartoum Road and 33-39 Talavera Road, Macquarie Park (Lot 1 DP 633221). The Department's assessment gives a CIV of approximately $263.6 million and a development that 'presents as a five-storey warehouse building'; the retired SITE_STOCKLAND_MP row described a five-storey Macquarie Park data centre at A$264m. Same site, same scale, same proponent group: the two rows were one project recorded twice, not two stages. The author approved the merge on 2026-11-15. SITE_STOCKLAND_MP is removed from data/seed_data.py and every pack referencing it repointed; SITE_MACQUARIE_PARK_DC survives, with the address corrected to include the Talavera Road frontage and the retired row's unsourced claims (AWS end-user, under-construction status, September 2026 start) recorded as claims under RG-102 rather than adopted. NOT merged: SSD-63235720 (Stockland Development Pty Limited, 1-5 Khartoum Road, Part Lot 2 DP 1043041, 76.4 MW maximum power consumption) is a separate consent on a separate lot and remains SITE_KHARTOUM; the Talavera Road campus expansion (SSD-24299707, Macquarie Data Centres) and the Goodman consent at 4-10 Talavera Road are also separate records.

research_gaps.question: Who is the end user of the Macquarie Park Data Centre (SSD-10467, Stockland Trust Management Limited, 11-17 Khartoum Road and 33-39 Talavera Road), and has construction started? The retired SITE_STOCKLAND_MP row reported AWS and a north-zone start in September 2026; no archived source states either.
research_gaps.why_it_matters: An anchor hyperscaler tenancy and a construction start change both the Sydney north-zone pipeline and who the NSW approvals are actually for. These claims entered the record from a grade-C directory that does not mention the project, so they are the weakest provenance in the Macquarie Park cluster and survived a merge only as claims.
research_gaps.target_source: Stockland project pages and ASX announcements; the NSW Planning Portal record for SSD-10467 (staging plan, construction certificate, any modification); AWS Australian infrastructure announcements
research_gaps.notes: OPENED 2026-11-15 by the RG-084 merge. The seed row cited SRC_CERTSTRAT for 'A$264m', 'for AWS' and 'a north-zone start in September 2026'. The archived article (data/raw/operators/certifiedstrategic/) does not contain the word 'Stockland' - checked by this script and by curate_certstrat_review.py - so the citation never supported the claim. The consent itself records approval, not construction. Nothing here has been read that names an end user or a start date. Until one is, the surviving row keeps status 'approved' and no anchor tenant. One lead, no more: the NSW IDA release of 27 March 2026 lists 'Stockland Project A City of Ryde' (recorded separately as SITE_STOCKLAND_PROJA) and states '**NB: One IDA endorsed data centre not listed due to commercial sensitivities**'. Whether the withheld project is this one is unknown and is not assumed.
